description: Land Acquisition - Advance Tracing Nos. MO/KTR/2015/729 and MO/KTR/2016/128 and MO/KTR/2015/753 of Kataragama, Kataragama D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition declarations under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing parcels of land needed for public purposes (construction of pump houses for a sewerage project). It contains detailed land descriptions including location, extent, boundaries, and survey references, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
